unavailable.title: Couldn't load the solver
unavailable.text: The server didn't respond just now. Please try again in a moment.

notFound.title: Solver not found
notFound.text: The link may be incomplete. Pick a solver from the store to continue.

platformFree.title: {name} is free
platformFree.text: This solver is already included in the platform: no price, no license. Just connect Solvers to your AI and start using it.

pay.title: Pay with Stripe
pay.text: You'll finish the payment on Stripe's secure page. When it's done you come back to your library and the solver is ready to use in Claude or ChatGPT.
pay.signInFirst: You'll sign in with your email first, then go straight to payment.
pay.testMode: Test mode: use Stripe's test card 4242 4242 4242 4242 with any future date and CVC.

owned.title: You already own this solver
owned.text: It's in your library. No need to buy it again.

how.title: What you get
how.s1: Lifetime access to the solver in the AI assistant you already use, through the Solvers connector.
how.s2: Every step it takes is proven by running real code in a CreateOS sandbox before it moves on.
how.s3: Updates from the creator are included at no extra cost.

summary.oneTime: One-time payment in US dollars. Taxes, if any, are shown by Stripe.
